maria.g: Quick flag — noticed a regression in 8xA100 PP runs after the kernel-selector tweak landed yesterday. 95th/99th token latency up ~10-15% on long sequences (>=2k).

kai: ugh. which change specifically? commit?

maria.g: commit 9f3b2a7 — changed kernel selection priority for matmul to prefer fp16-fused path for small batch dims. thought it would help but profiling shows more all-reduce stalls in the backward pass.

devon: can you paste the perf summary? even a cropped nvprof/ncu snippet works.

maria.g: pasted below — filtered to the PP bubble window. notice all-reduce spikes aligning with microbatch boundary (1f1b windows).
```
PROFILE: run=exp/2026-03-16/8gpu/longseq
step 120-125 (1F1B)
compute_time_avg: 18.2ms
allreduce_time_avg: 6.9ms (was 3.4ms baseline)
kvcache_hit: 87%
microbatch_size: 8
KV prefetch latency spikes: 0.8ms -> 4.2ms at boundaries
kernel-selector: 9f3b2a7
```

sasha: interesting — allreduce doubled. could be the fused kernel changing the op ordering so gradient buffers flush differently. also KV prefetch spike at boundaries could be exacerbating comm/compute overlap.

kai: two quick experiments: 1) revert selector on a canary commit and rerun 2) reduce microbatch from 8->4 to see if bubble shrinks.

maria.g: started a canary revert run (2167004365). also launched microbatch=4 run (2167004380).

perf-bot: canary revert run 2167004365 completed — tail latency improved ~6%, allreduce avg 3.8ms.

ops-jen: noting for rollout — can we get a minimal repro and a perf regression issue? tag owners.

devon: looks like the selector change moved some matmuls off the cuBLAS path to our custom-fused kernel which has a slightly different synchronization pattern. that pattern delays ready-to-send flags for the allreduce. easiest short-term is revert, mid-term is tweak kernel to set NVSHMEM/comm-ready earlier or pre-seed the gradient buffer.

maria.g: agreed. filed perf-regress/317 with logs + profile + commands. linking the runs: http://ci/internal/runs/2167004365 and /2167004380.

kai: for the kvcache spikes, could be that the fused kernel increases memory pressure around KV prefetch threads. try increasing kvcache prefetch thread pool to 4 for the canary and see.

maria.g: good call — kicking another run with kvcache.prefetch_threads=4 (2167004410).

perf-bot: run 2167004410 in progress — ETA 45m.

sasha: once we confirm revert fixes, we'll schedule a micro-rollback to reduce user impact. long-term: add a microbenchmark that exercises small-batch matmul + 1F1B to catch this in CI.

devon: adding a lightweight synthetic: matmul-fused-smallbatch + kvcache-stress harness. will push to perf-tests tomorrow.

maria.g: thanks all. action items: (1) keep canary revert until kernel fixes (kai + devon) (2) add regression test (devon) (3) monitor kvcache prefetch effect (maria.g). marking thread resolved when run 2167004410 finishes. :thumbsup:
